options.description: The run ends and names why the merge check held the fix. You decide the next step. No question is sent to you. Recommended: You asked to be asked through the question tool when fixing implies changing the intent. A merge the check holds is not that case, so stopping and reporting matches your words.
options.label: Stop and report why (Recommended)

options.description: The run pauses and sends you a question about the held fix before it goes on.
options.label: Ask me through the question tool

payload.question:
When plumb evaluate's merge check holds a fix, should plumb stop and report why, or should it ask you through the question tool what to do?

You said on 21 Oct: "Of course it should come back to the user with question tool when fixing implies changing the intent"
